question: Compare the agriculture/fishing and manufacturing panels in Figure 5.11 between 2010 and 2020. Which sector loses workers and which gains, and what skill color dominates agriculture?
answer:
Between 2010 and 2020, agriculture and fishing loses workers while manufacturing gains workers. [p161-figure-5.11]

The dominant skill color in agriculture and fishing is unskilled manual. [p161-figure-5.11]
